title: Bee hum

scenes.headline: Honey bees at the last water in the canyon.

caption:
Fifteen seconds of bee hum.

Honey bee foragers usually stay within about 3 km of the hive, but can fly 8–13 km for food or water.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Apis mellifera). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Sound-led loop: real clip of wild honey bees drinking in a desert canyon, then slow close-ups on flowers; minimal text, ambient bed.
